signature_moves: Capture overlay mirrors the OS's own screenshot tool (marquee + crosshair) — Jakob's Law reuse of an owned mental model; the one genuine product-design idea visible
Jewel-bright feature isolation: each capability its own saturated card hue against a calm indigo backdrop (brand layer)

psychology: Jakob's Law — capture overlay copies the native macOS screenshot affordance so the interaction is instantly understood
Von Restorff (isolation) — each feature gets a distinct saturated card, making three capabilities individually memorable
Picture-superiority / recognition-over-recall — features are shown (QR panel, waveform, live capture) rather than described
Aesthetic-Usability Effect — polished bright collage primes perceived quality of the utility
